init_elmo_connector: initialize an Elmo connector with model directory, vocab, and warm-up cycles from args
get_batch_generation: get batch generation log probabilities, token IDs, and masked indices for a list of sentences
get_contextual_embeddings: get contextual embeddings and sentence lengths from the ELMo BiLm model for a list of sentences
optimize_top_layer: optimize the ELMo top layer by reinitializing output weights for a given vocabulary subset
get_id: get token IDs for a string by looking up each word in the inverse vocabulary
